eligible_source: independent multi-year Korean corpus with >=4 consecutive annual states in same frozen environment key
environment_key: source-family × serialization/representation × stable source/publisher × exact topic/genre where available
horizons: anchored y->y+1,y+2,y+3 with all intermediate years present
support_controls: min 200 documents each year when feasible
primary_comparison: fine/exclusive-event eta versus quotient eta on matched chains
prohibited: retuning marker inventory from external result
calling non-unit eta holonomy or curvature
pooling unmatched environment trajectories to improve significance
